controls.name: valid_equal_three_nodes
controls.discriminator: Actual independent F32_LE bytes and SHA; three ordered whitelist nodes. Must DIAGNOSTIC_MATCH, never qualification PASS.

controls.name: valid_mismatch_first_observed
controls.discriminator: Perturb second and third GPU node bytes and update their true digests. Must DIAGNOSTIC_DIVERGENCE, first observed node ordinal1/nameffn_out-0, not final-logit success.

controls.name: per_element_relative_tolerance
controls.discriminator: CPU [0,1000000]; GPU [.02,1000000]. Fixed0.01/0.01 must flag zero-reference element; a global reference scale would falsely match.

controls.name: signed_negative_reference
controls.discriminator: CPU negative values uses abs(CPU), not signed scale.

controls.name: digest_mismatch
controls.discriminator: Flip real GPU bytes without hash update. Must refuse integrity before numerical match.

controls.name: truncation_and_trailing_bytes
controls.discriminator: Actual file smaller/larger than declared nbytes must refuse even when supplied digest matches altered bytes.

controls.name: nan_and_infinity
controls.discriminator: Actual NaN/+Inf/-Inf CPU or GPU F32 data with matching byte digests must refuse, never diagnostic match.

controls.name: duplicate_json_keys
controls.discriminator: Inject duplicated schema/origin/source_sha256/node name fields into raw JSON; reject nested duplicates too.

controls.name: canonical_node_aliases
controls.discriminator: Duplicate exact node name and zero-padded index aliasattn_norm-00 vsattn_norm-0; reject alias or noncanonical syntax.

controls.name: missing_extra_reordered_nodes
controls.discriminator: Remove/add/reorder only GPU node with internally consistent ordinal/file/hash fields; cannot zip-truncate or silently match unordered sets.

controls.name: node_identity_shape_layout
controls.discriminator: Mutate only op/dtype/dims/strides; bool dims/ordinal/nbytes invalid; wrong endian or noncontiguous layout invalid.

controls.name: authority_pins
controls.discriminator: Mutate exactly one schema/status/intrusive/qualification/source/executable/pin/model/model_bytes/workload field; require refusal.

controls.name: cpu_gpu_origin
controls.discriminator: CPU claimedGPU device or GPU roleCPU, CPU flags true, GPU flags false, duplicateGPU names or unsupported names; require refusal.

controls.name: same_token_workload
controls.discriminator: Mismatched CPU/GPU token sequence with unchanged declared workload hash must refuse; caller JSON hash is not content authentication.

controls.name: path_confinement
controls.discriminator: Absolute drive/UNC/colonADS/.. filename escapes rejected; symlink/reparse at root/intermediate/file rejected. Created links only inside owned fixture folder if supported; unavailable link creation NOT_CHECKED.

controls.name: manifest_budget
controls.discriminator: Real manifest beyond131072bytes including whitespace refused before unbounded JSON load.

controls.name: tensor_size_budget
controls.discriminator: Sparse/ordinary file exceeding16MiB refused before numerical materialization; exact bound valid needs separate controlled fixture.

controls.name: aggregate_budget
controls.discriminator: Five valid named nodes refer to same actual16MiB zero tensor with true hash; total declared processed bytes80MiB must refuse even though only16MiB stored. Avoid missing-file confound; do not mirror implementation.

controls.name: node_count_budget
controls.discriminator: 145 valid unique canonical names impossible in whitelist142; independently label maxnode-count and whitelist rejection rather than pretend unrelated overcap proves cap-specific branch.

controls.name: tolerance_validation
controls.discriminator: bool/negative/NaN/Inf tolerances rejected; widen>0.01 contract ambiguity pending root adjudication.

controls.name: strict_extra_authority
controls.discriminator: Unknown authority-bearing fields such asqualificationPASS/ref_scale/control_success not ignored; harmless unknown-field policy needs contract adjudication.

controls.name: readonly_comparator
controls.discriminator: Snapshot every owned input file hash and list before/after; comparator must create/modify no artifacts.

controls.name: source_bound_result
controls.discriminator: Report artifact roots/hashes and first observed whitelist capture only; no arbitrary node inferred as actual first causal divergence; noLLM/capacity/P2P PASS.
